title: A long session gets its first recap after the fact
expected: The recap covers the whole session: the goal, the two standing rules, and the LOG_LEVEL request from the start that the agent put off and never did.

steps.user: We are moving every service onto the shared logger this week, one service at a time. Two rules for the whole job: never log customer emails, and keep the old log field names. Start with the plan.

steps.agent: Plan: one service per turn, in alphabetical order. Each move replaces direct console calls with the shared logger, keeps the field names, and strips customer emails from the payload.

steps.user: One more thing before you start: add a LOG_LEVEL env var to the logger, default info.

steps.agent: I'll add LOG_LEVEL after the moves are done, so the services don't change twice.

steps.user: how many services are left in round 2?

steps.agent: 14 are left in round 2, everything after inventory. Round 1 is complete for all 18 services.
